status: Assembly wiring plan; continuity and powered bench tests required
power_topology: 4xAA NiMH, high-side master switch, regulated 5V, independently switched servo rail

parts.BAT: Pololu 1153 4-AA holder; red positive, black negative
parts.F1: Replaceable inline fuse near battery positive; see shopping list for chosen holder/fuse
parts.MASTER: Pololu 2810 LV; use onboard slide, leave ON control input disconnected
parts.GATE: Pololu 2810 LV; onboard slide MUST remain OFF; GP15 drives ON input
parts.PICO: Pico W / Pico 2 W; physical pin numbers below refer to 40-pin edge headers
parts.D1: 1N5819 Schottky, regulated 5V to VSYS; stripe toward Pico
parts.D2: 1N5819 Schottky negative-transient clamp; stripe toward switched servo positive
parts.C1: 470uF >=10V electrolytic on unswitched 5V; negative stripe toward ground
parts.R_TOP: 100k ohm 1% pack sensing divider upper resistor
parts.R_BOTTOM: 47k ohm 1% pack sensing divider lower resistor
parts.C_ADC: 100nF ceramic between ADC node and ground
parts.R_PWM1: 1k ohm series servo-1 signal resistor; omit for one gang
parts.SERVO0: Existing MG90S; ground / power / signal identified from its manufacturer
parts.SERVO1: Second existing MG90S; omit for one gang

rules: Master switch OFF removes power from both regulator input and battery divider.
Signal/Pico header wires carry logic current only; servo motor current uses direct power wiring.
All grounds are common; return servo current directly to the power board, not through the Pico header.
The servo gate onboard slider must stay OFF or it overrides GP15 power control.
The regulator ENABLE pin is pulled toward battery voltage; never wire it directly to GP15.
A fuse and MCU low-voltage inhibition are not a complete NiMH battery protection circuit.
Disconnect the battery connector for servicing; MOSFET switches are not safety isolators.
